# 42 Chat

> Chat em tempo real para a 42 São Paulo (~300 alunos). Go + React + Postgres.

## Stack

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Guia completo do projeto — stack, pipeline SDD, constraints, gatilhos

## Features

### Domínio

- [100 — 42 Chat Core](specs/features/100-42chat-core/spec.md): MVP do chat — OAuth2 42, WebSocket, sala "general", tema brutalista, Docker Compose
- [100 — 42 Chat Core — Plan](specs/features/100-42chat-core/plan.md): ADRs de autenticação, WebSocket hub, schema PostgreSQL
- [101 — Assinatura de Participação](specs/features/101-assinatura-participacao/spec.md): UserSignature inline com tiers (Lurker → Sage), stats em tempo real via WebSocket

### Pipeline SDD

- [006 — Agent Dev](specs/features/006-agent-dev/spec.md): Subagente implementador — recebe task atômica, gera código funcional com smoke test
- [007 — Agent QA](specs/features/007-agent-qa/spec.md): Subagente QA — valida implementações contra spec, escreve Gherkin, pode rejeitar tasks
- [008 — Reavaliação Skills](specs/features/008-reavaliacao-skills/spec.md): Consolidação de ~130 skills em toolkits unificados (brain, sdd, devops)
- [009 — Start Repo](specs/features/009-start-repo/spec.md): Estrutura de diretórios SDD — constitution, tech, specs, agents
- [010 — SDD Templates](specs/features/010-sdd-templates/spec.md): Templates canônicos (spec, plan, tasks, AGENTS.md, llms.txt) + refactor artifact
- [011 — Forge Skill](specs/features/011-forge-skill/spec.md): Skill Hermes para criar novas skills com estrutura padronizada e validação
- [012 — Tasks DAG](specs/features/012-sdd-tasks-dag/spec.md): Upgrade do sdd-generate-tasks para formato DAG com paralelismo e isolamento
- [013 — Runtime Orchestrator](specs/features/013-runtime-orchestrator/spec.md): Execução automática do DAG com agent-dev + agent-qa em paralelo

### Framework (42_Framework)

- [001 — LATTE Coordination](specs/features/001-latte-coordination/spec.md): Coordination graph dinâmico com 7 operadores e heartbeat monitoring
- [002 — Wiki Experiential Memory](specs/features/002-experiential-memory/spec.md): Índice SQLite + embeddings com chunker, store, search, scoring, feedback
- [003 — Hybrid Retrieval](specs/features/003-hybrid-retrieval/spec.md): Busca híbrida BM25 + cosine similarity (α=0.7)
- [004 — jschan Forum Manager](specs/features/004-jschan-forum-manager/spec.md): Skill CRUD de boards jschan via mongosh + wiki documentation
- [005 — LATTE Hardening](specs/features/005-latte-hardening/spec.md): Budget tracking, timeout, failure propagation, verify deterministic (7 ADRs)

### References — Papers

- [LATTE](wiki/references/papers/LATTE.md): Language Agent Teams for Task Evolution — coordination graph dinâmico

- [LangGraph in Production](wiki/references/papers/LangGraph-in-Production.md): StateGraph, checkpointing, state pruning, human-in-the-loop
- [LangGraph vs LangChain](wiki/references/papers/LangGraph-vs-LangChain.md): Decision matrix + validação do LATTE como custom loop
